method: Section start: CardSegmentStartTime of the matching bout in UFC.com's event feed (d29dxerjsp82wz.cloudfront.net/api/v3/event/live/{fmid}.json), matched by accent-folded last names; every row matched exactly one bout.

Odds: fetch_odds.py writes only when odds change and only for events dated today or later (UTC), and logs each write. The archived odds are traced to the last logged write with the same prices. With no such write, the row is clean if no run could have written after the section started, or if every such run is logged; otherwise its capture time is unknown.
